core_style.sentence_shape: compound runs with personal anecdotes and reflections
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative - driven by enthusiasm and storytelling
core_style.two_registers: formal during public speaking engagements, casual in personal anecdotes and interviews

humor.frequency: occasional - often when reflecting on past experiences
humor.mechanism: understatement - downplaying his own achievements or experiences for comedic effect

structural_patterns: poses a question then answers it immediately
uses personal anecdotes to illustrate points
speech_signature.naming_behavior: uses first names and titles to create familiarity and connection with the audience
speech_signature.candor_register: shorter and more direct when off-script, often using humor or personal stories

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: bodybuilding and fitness terminology, reflecting his expertise in physical training and health
vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: frequent use of rhetorical questions and pauses for emphasis

worldview.success is achievable: demonstrated through personal stories of overcoming obstacles and achieving goals
worldview.importance of hard work: consistently emphasizes the need to work hard to turn visions into reality

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: a driven individual who has achieved great success through hard work and vision
self_image_vs_reality.reality: often reflects on the sacrifices made and the challenges faced along the way
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: when confronted with the gap, he emphasizes the importance of resilience and learning from failures

emotional_tells.when_uncertain: redirects questions or emphasizes the importance of hard work and vision
emotional_tells.when_in_control: speaks confidently, uses assertive language, and maintains eye contact

response_patterns.when_disagreeing: reframes the discussion to focus on shared goals or values
response_patterns.when_pressed_for_specifics: delivers concrete examples from personal experience
response_patterns.when_proven_wrong: redirects the conversation or acknowledges the point without losing confidence
response_patterns.when_interviewing_vs_interviewed: more relaxed and candid when interviewed, more assertive and directive when interviewing

social_positioning.desired_position: seen as a relatable and inspirational figure who motivates others
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: respected and admired, often seen as a mentor figure
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his public persona and personal struggles, which he addresses candidly
